title: The two arms finding-09 left unfinished: reveal sampling on top of the fourth ply, and the depth-3 ladder at full joint coverage
hypothesis: On the shared 64-game development cohort 0xa51d1000-0xa51d103f, factoring the chance node keeps paying when it is applied on top of the fourth ply: depth 4 with seven disc samples and two reveal samples beats depth 4 with seven disc samples and one reveal sample with a one-sided 95% whole-game bootstrap lower bound above zero. Separately, the depth-3 ladder continues to order with joint (disc, reveal) coverage: twelve reveal samples (100% joint coverage) is at least as strong as six (85.7%).

candidate.name: factored-chance-fair-search, arms d4 N=7 M=2 and d3 N=7 M=12

comparator.name: the recorded single-reveal-sample arms on the same seeds (d4 N=7 M=1 = runs/RUN-A51D-s7confirm/fresh-s7.json; d4 N=5 M=1 = runs/RUN-A51D-s7confirm/fresh-s5.json) and finding-09's completed depth-3 ladder (M=1, 3, 6)

data.reuseDisclosure: The 64 evaluation seeds 0xa51d1000-0xa51d103f were opened by finding-05's fresh-seed confirmation and read again by finding-09; they are permanently development data and are reused here so the new arms pair seed-for-seed with the recorded ones. Nothing here is confirmation evidence and no protected or final seed is read. Each arm is run as four sequential 16-game chunks at seed starts +0x00, +0x10, +0x20, +0x30, which plays exactly the 64 cohort seeds once each. No machine-readable seed-lease record exists for the 0xa5 family; the authoritative allocation is docs/exploratory/lease-map.md.

metrics.primary: Paired candidate-minus-comparator mean score over whole games with a one-sided 95% percentile-bootstrap lower bound (20,000 resamples, seed 0xb0075eed).
secondary: numbered clears per move, covered reveals per move and mean occupied cells
logical work per move and the work multiplier against each comparator
score at near-equal work: depth 3 with six reveal samples against depth 4 with one
bound diagnostics: decisions, decisions below target depth, work-limit events, minimum completed depth, maximum work in one decision
pooling validity: four pooled 16-game chunks must reproduce a single 64-game run field-for-field, including summed logical work
censored games and score-decomposition identity failures
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: One-sided percentile bootstrap over whole paired games, 20,000 resamples, seed 0xb0075eed, as implemented in approaches/lifetime-objective/reveal-sampling/stats.py. An incomplete arm is paired only on the seeds it shares with its comparator and the paired n is printed with every such row.

passCriteria: Pooling validity: pooling four 16-game chunks reproduces the corresponding single 64-game artifact on all 13 recorded per-game fields with 0 mismatches and identical summed logical work.
Bound diagnostics: 0 decisions below target depth and 0 work-limit events in every arm; an arm that completed a shallower depth than requested is void.
Depth 4 with two reveal samples beats depth 4 with one reveal sample on the complete 64-game cohort with a one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound above zero.
Depth 3 with twelve reveal samples is at least as strong as depth 3 with six on the seeds they share.
0 censored games and 0 score-decomposition identity failures in every arm.
gate.failureAction: Record a valid negative for the exact dose tested and state the dose explicitly: a failure at two reveal samples is not a failure of reveal sampling at depth 4, because two samples is a smaller joint-coverage increment than the six that first cleared noise at depth 3. Do not launch a wider depth-4 arm without a cost estimate from measured work.
gate.passAction: Preregister a fresh-seed replication of the compounding configuration on an unread development block, and only then consider it a candidate reference.

stopConditions: Stop an arm if any decision completes below its requested depth or a work-limit event occurs; the arm is void.
Stop on any score-decomposition identity failure or illegal move.
Stop on any read of a seed outside 0xa51d1000-0xa51d103f.
Back off while the machine's one-minute load exceeds 26, and after a bounded grace period proceed at a reduced thread count rather than surrendering the arm.
Stop on out-of-memory or on host available memory falling below 16 GiB.

amendments.reason: Registered retroactively. The two arms are the ones finding-09 explicitly left open: docs/exploratory/finding-09-reveal-sampling.md names the depth-4 two-reveal-sample arm as 'the highest-value open arm, because it is the only way to learn whether the two axes compound rather than substitute' and the depth-3 twelve-reveal-sample arm as a deliberate no-run, both written before either arm produced a game. The launch protocol - four sequential 16-game chunks over the shared cohort, an explicit per-configuration --max-work, and the auto-sized cache - is fixed in approaches/lifetime-objective/reveal-sampling/run-arms.sh, which predates the data. This machine-readable record was written after execution by a different agent than the one that ran them; the comparison rule is the standing paired whole-game bootstrap implemented in approaches/lifetime-objective/reveal-sampling/stats.py.

lifecycle set to running, not completed: the depth-3 twelve-reveal-sample arm was on its third chunk (32 of 64 games pooled) when the result record was written. The depth-4 two-reveal-sample arm is complete at 64 of 64.
